blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are a predominant architecture for computer vision, with token reduction emerging as a popular paradigm to improve their efficiency. Prior work compares reduction algorithms, but not how models respond to them, nor how their response changes with model depth. We propose Monte Carlo Token Pruning (MCTP), which estimates each token's impact on the prediction when tokens are explicitly removed during the forward pass. Applying MCTP to recent pretrained models, we observe that most, such as DINOv3, maintain a similar ranking of token importance at every depth (high Coherent Aggregation), while SigLIP 2 does not. This coherence requires predictions to survive pruning, which depends on keeping high-norm "sink" tokens: prefix tokens are kept by design, while prefix-free SigLIP 2 forms them on patch tokens, which pruning may remove. We show that in removing DINOv3's prefix tokens, its predictions and coherence collapse, while protecting only 5 tokens for SigLIP 2 cuts the token impact outside the object's bounding box by up to 62%. Beyond this, MCTP offers a post-hoc method to evaluate how a pretrained ViT responds to pruning, and suggests that token reduction methods should keep "sinks".
blocks.zh: Vision Transformers(ViTs)是计算机视觉的主导架构,象征性的减少逐渐成为提高其效率的流行范例. 先前的工作比较还原算法,但不包括模型如何响应,也不包括模型深度如何改变反应. 我们提议Monte Carlo Token Pruning(MCTP),它估计每个信使在前行时明确去除信使时对预测的影响. 将MCTP应用到最近经过预先训练的模型中,我们观察到,大多数,如DINOv3,在每一个深度(高度协同聚合)都保持类似的象征性重要性排名,而SigLIP 2则没有. 这种一致性需要预测以活下来的普鲁因,这取决于保留高规范的"沉"符号:前缀符号通过设计保存,而前缀免费的SigLIP 2则在补丁符号上形成它们,普鲁因可能会去掉. 我们显示,在移除DINOv3的前缀符时,它的预测和一致性崩溃,同时只保护了SigLIP 2的5个符符符,将符符符撞击到对象的边框外,可达62%. 除此之外,MCTP还提供了一种后热法,用来评价一个经过预训的VIT如何应对挤压,并建议令牌还原方法应当保持"沉".

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: ViT ( ViT ) are the prevalent architecture for image recognition [ 25 , 69 , 70 , 32 ] , vision-language tasks [ 57 , 83 , 71 , 18 , 12 , 11 , 81 ] , dense recognition [ 58 , 67 , 17 , 40 , 3 ] and 3D understanding [ 74 , 75 , 16 ] . The architecture scales well with both parameter count and dataset size [ 82 , 23 ] , leading ViT to be the popular candidate for general-purpose feature extraction from frozen or fine-tuned pretrained foundation models [ 14 , 55 , 64 , 34 , 5 , 28 , 71 , 30 ] .

blocks.en: A core component of the ViT which contributes to its strong representational capacity is the use of MHSA ( MHSA ) to consolidate context across all image tokens; however, this comes at the cost of quadratic computational complexity in the number of image tokens, N N : 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) . The computational overhead resulting from this quadratic scaling is significant and as such, a substantial subfield of research has emerged exploring methods to reduce the number of tokens and thereby mitigate this impact. These methodological paradigms include: token pruning [ 59 , 49 , 45 , 6 , 61 , 81 , 78 , 29 ] , whereby tokens are identified to be dropped from the sequence, token merging [ 9 , 10 , 53 , 42 , 48 , 16 , 85 , 60 ] , where similar tokens are combined into one, and adaptive patch sizing [ 19 , 41 , 54 ] , which allocates different token budgets to different regions of an image. These methods vary substantially in their pruning criteria, as well as the transformer depths at which these decisions are made.
blocks.zh: ViT中一个有助于其强大的代表能力的核心组成部分是使用MHSA(MHSA)来整合所有图像符号的上下文;然而,这是以图像符号数的四相计算复杂性为代价的,N N : O (N 2 )\ mathcal{O}(NQX)2}. 这种四面缩放产生的计算间接费用相当可观,因此,出现了一个重大的分研究领域,探索减少信使数量从而减轻这种影响的方法。 这些方法范式包括:将符号分出[59、49、45、6、61、81、78、29],从序列中确定将符号分出,将符号合并[9、10、53、42、48、16、85、60],将类似符号合并为一;将[19、41、54]适应性补丁分出[19、41、54],将不同的符号预算分配给不同的图像区域。 这些方法在裁量标准以及这些决定的变压器深度方面差别很大。

blocks.en: Prior work [ 33 ] systematically investigates token reduction methods, exploring how the performance of different methods varies when changing the keep rates, DeiT [ 69 ] backbone capacities, and datasets. They primarily examine the token reduction algorithms themselves but do not explore how the response to token reduction may vary between existing pretrained models. This leaves a number of open questions as to the kind of differences pretrained ViT may exhibit under token reduction, such as which tokens are important and how consistent that stays throughout the depth of the model.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作[33]系统地调查了符号还原方法,探讨了不同方法在改变保存率,DeiT[69]主干能力和数据集时的表现如何不同. 他们主要检查符号还原算法本身,但不探索对符号还原的反应如何在现有的预先训练的模型中发生差异. 由此留下了一些未解的问题,如预先训练的ViT在象征性的减量下可能显示出何种差异,例如哪些符号很重要,在模型的整个深度中如何保持一致。

blocks.en: To investigate the impact of token reduction on various pretrained ViT , we introduce MCTP ( MCTP ): a framework which prunes random token subsets at multiple depths and measures the effect on the prediction. This allows us to estimate not only which regions are important but also how that importance varies throughout the model depth.
blocks.zh: 为了调查符号还原对各种被预先训练过的VIT的影响,我们引入了MCTP(MCTP):一个在多深度处推倒随机符号子集并测量对预测的影响的框架. 这使得我们不仅能够估计哪些区域是重要的,而且能够估计这种重要性在整个模型深度中有何不同。

blocks.en: Under our MCTP framework, we show that most pretrained models remain consistent in which regions carry the largest impact under token removal throughout the full transformer depth, see . We term this Coherent Aggregation . For these models, the regions with the largest impact also fall mostly within the object’s bounding box, showing high MCTP object alignment.
blocks.zh: 在我们的MCTP框架下,我们显示,大多数经过预先培训的模型仍然一致,在这种模型中,各区域在整个变压器深度中在象征性清除下产生最大影响,见......。 我们称之为和谐的聚合。 对于这些模型来说,影响最大的区域也大多属于物体的边框内,显示出高度的MCTP物体对接.

blocks.en: However, SigLIP 2 exhibits low Coherent Aggregation and low MCTP object alignment. Unlike the other models, it has no prefix tokens, so “sink” tokens [ 22 , 38 , 62 , 79 ] , high-norm tokens that hold global image context, form on patch tokens that pruning can remove. Protecting the 5 highest-norm tokens at the point of pruning improves both its Coherent Aggregation and MCTP object alignment.
blocks.zh: 然而,SigLIP 2表现出了较低的相干聚合和较低的MCTP对象对齐. 与其他模型不同的是,它没有前缀符号,因此"沉入"符号[22,38,62,79],高规范符号,能持有全局图像上下文,在补丁符号上形成可以去掉的活塞. 保护5个最出格的标点标语,既能改善它的和谐聚合,又能改善MCTP对象对齐.

blocks.en: Contributions. To summarise, our contributions are: • We propose MCTP ( MCTP ) to estimate a model’s token impact under pruning at varying transformer depths ( Sec. 3.2 ). • We observe that most pretrained models remain consistent in which regions they find impactful under token pruning throughout the full transformer depth: high Coherent Aggregation ( Sec. 4.1 ). • We find that classes with a larger spread of token impact give more stable predictions under pruning, and that coherent models concentrate this impact on the object: high MCTP object alignment ( Sec. 4.2 ). • We show that pruning “sink” tokens, cause predictions to collapse, and that protecting SigLIP 2’s highest-norm tokens at the point of pruning improves its MCTP object alignment and prediction stability ( Sec. 4.3 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our work draws on four areas of research: efficient transformers, token pruning, perturbation-based attribution, and the high-norm “sink” tokens that form inside ViT .
blocks.zh: 我们的工作借鉴了四个研究领域:高效的变压器、象征性的冲刷、以扰动为基础的归属,以及Vit内部形成的高规范的“沉”符号。

blocks.en: Efficient Transformers. With the widespread application of ViT , improving their efficiency is a popular research domain [ 27 , 51 , 63 , 35 , 52 , 43 , 39 ] . In this work, we focus primarily on efficiency through token pruning.
blocks.zh: 高效变形器。 随着VIT的广泛应用,提高它们的效率是一个受欢迎的研究领域[27,51,63,35,52,43,39]. 在这项工作中,我们主要侧重于通过象征性的搜索提高效率。

blocks.en: Token Pruning. Token pruning methods differ in the signal they use to select which tokens to keep. Attention-based methods utilise attention maps or scores to guide token removal [ 61 , 49 , 81 , 29 ] and learned predictors are trained to make the pruning decision [ 59 , 6 ] . They also prune at different depths, from several blocks throughout the encoder [ 49 , 59 , 6 , 78 ] to once after it [ 81 ] . Some, such as ATS [ 29 ] and VisionZip [ 81 ] , can also prune without any further training, so the pretrained model is never adapted to the tokens they remove. Haurum et al. [33] compare these methods with each other, while we study how pretrained models respond to token removal at each depth.
blocks.zh: 托肯普鲁宁. Token pruning方法在选择要保存的符号时所使用的信号不同. 基于注意力的方法利用注意图或分数来指导符号去除[61,49,81,29],而已学到的预测器则经过训练来作出推敲决定[59,6]. 它们在不同的深度,从整个编码器的几个区块[49、59、6、78]到其后[81]一次。 有些,如ATS[29]和VisionZip[81],也可以不经过任何再培训而作prune,因此预先训练的模型从不适应它们去除的道具. 豪鲁姆等. [33] 将这些方法相提并论,同时我们研究预先训练过的模型如何响应每个深度的符号去除.

blocks.en: Perturbation-based Attribution. Perturbation methods score image regions by how the prediction changes when they are masked [ 21 ] , often by Monte Carlo sampling. RISE [ 56 ] weights random masks by the model’s output on each masked image.
blocks.zh: 以扰为本. 扰动方法通过被遮掩后预测的变化来评分图像区域[21],常由蒙特卡洛取样. RISE[56]根据模型在每个被遮住的图像上的输出来加权随机口罩.

blocks.en: For transformers, ViT-Shapley [ 20 ] masks patches through attention from the input onwards, so removes them only at the input, and trains an explainer to estimate their Shapley values. Most ViT attribution methods build maps from attention, patch embeddings or token norms without removing tokens [ 1 , 15 , 80 , 77 ] . Closest to our work, Wang et al. [76] remove single visual tokens inside the LLM component from a VLM ( VLM ) and measure the change in its output; we extend this to Monte Carlo-sampled regions of tokens removed inside the ViT encoder. Saliency maps are commonly evaluated by their rank agreement under perturbation [ 31 , 2 ] , and by how much of their mass falls on annotated objects [ 44 , 4 , 62 ] .
blocks.zh: 对于变压器,ViT-Shapley [20]口罩从输入后通过注意来补上,所以只在输入时去掉,并训练出一个解释器来估计它们的变压值. 多数 VIT的归属方法从注意,补丁嵌入或符号规范中构建出地图,而不去掉符号[1,15,80,77]. 最贴近工作 王等. [76] 从 VLM (VLM) 组件中去除 LLM 内部的单个可视化符号, 并测量其输出的变化; 我们把这个扩展至 Monte Carlo 所标注的 VIT 编码器内去除的符号区域 。 显著性地图通常通过它们在扰动情况下的等级协议[31,2],以及其质量有多少落在注解对象上[44,4,62]来评估.

blocks.en: Sink Tokens. StreamingLLM [ 79 ] established that models disproportionately focus on the first tokens in a sequence, which they term “attention sinks”. In a similar vein, Darcet et al. [22] find that artefacts form in the attention maps of modern ViT , caused by high-norm outlier tokens on redundant background patches, at positions that vary between images. They remove these outliers by adding learned register prefix tokens that take over the high-norm context from the background patches. Jiang et al. [38] find that the high-norm tokens appear approximately at block 6 and are caused by highly activating register neurons in intermediate MLP ( MLP ) layers. At test time, they move these activations into an added register by zeroing the neurons at patch tokens and writing their maximum activation to the register. Shi et al. [62] argue that these high-norm tokens are one symptom of lazy aggregation, where image-level supervision leads ViT to encode global semantics in background patches, which registers alone do not fully address. Token pruning keeps prefix tokens such as [CLS] or registers by design [ 49 , 59 , 13 ] , much like the initial [BOS] token in LLM [ 79 ] ; without them, the sinks can only form on these background patches. Pruning methods do not target sink tokens explicitly, though attention-based or learned scores may keep them implicitly, as sinks draw most of the attention [ 81 ] .
blocks.zh: 辛克・托肯斯 CreatingLLM[79] 确定模型过分注重顺序上的第一个符号,它们称之为“意向汇”。 以相近之脉出达磨等. [22] 在现代VIT的注意地图中发现由多发背景补丁上高正标值外出符号所导致,在图像之间位置相差相差. 他们通过添加能从背景补丁中取出高规范上下文的已学习的注册前缀符号来去除这些出局符. 蒋等. [38]发现高正音符号大约出现在第6个区块上,由中间MLP(MLP)层高度活化的寄生神经元所引起. 在测试时,它们将这些活化器移入一个被添加的收存器,方法是将补丁符上的神经元零化并把它们的最大活化量写入收存器. 史等编. [62] 认为这些高规范符号是懒惰聚合的一个症状,图像级监督导致VIT在背景补丁中将全球语义编码,而仅登记本身并不能完全解决. Token pruning保留了诸如[CLS]或由设计[49,59,13]来注册等前缀符号,与LLM [79]中的初始[BOS]符号很像;没有这些后缀,汇只能在这些后缀上形成. 套汇方法并不明确地针对汇物,尽管基于注意力的或学到的分数可能会隐含地保留它们,因为汇会吸引大多数的注意力[81].

blocks.en: Q: Does the ranking of token importance stay the same when pruning at different depths?
blocks.zh: 问:在深度不同时,象征重要性的排名是否保持不变?

blocks.en: Experimental Setup. We run MCTP over the trained ViT-B/16 linear probes from DINOv3 [ 64 ] and SigLIP 2 [ 71 ] , with four additional backbones [ 30 , 69 , 12 , 28 ] and two other DINOv3 sizes in Tab. 1 and Supp. Sec. 8 . We chose these backbones to span the main pretraining objectives: self-distillation (DINOv3 [ 64 ] , and LingBot-Vision [ 30 ] with dense-feature improvements), supervised classification (DeiT [ 69 ] ), masked image modelling (EVA-02 [ 28 ] ) and image-text pretraining (TIPSv2 [ 12 ] and SigLIP 2 [ 71 ] ), with DINOv3 S/16 and L/16 varying model capacity. The protocol runs over the full 50,000 50{,}000 -image ImageNet-1k [ 24 ] validation set at 336 × 336 336\times 336 ( N = 441 N{=}441 ), at pruning depths l ∈ { 0 , 3 , 6 , 9 } l\in\{0,3,6,9\} . By default, we use the same seed, and so the same draws τ \tau , at every depth, which removes differences in τ \tau from the depth-wise correlations of token impact and makes them best-case estimates.

blocks.en: Spearman Correlation. This value is then averaged across the validation set. The mean Spearman across all pairwise depths is ρ \rho throughout the rest of this paper.

blocks.en: Off-Box Mass. Lastly, to validate an image’s token impact, and thus the verification of effective support, we follow a similar process to [ 44 , 4 , 62 ] . Using the object annotation boxes available for the ImageNet [ 24 ] validation set, we measure the proportion of positive token impact that lies outside of the bounding box. This allows us to quantify MCTP object alignment. We select off-box rather than in-box because objects rarely conform exactly to the annotated bounding box: the box gives an estimate of object location, so impact outside it is more reliably off the object, whereas impact inside it may still lie on background. Since MCTP considers token impact from the perspective of protecting the unpruned prediction, we only consider the case where y ^ = y \hat{y}=y , so that the highlighted impact relates to the bounding box. Consequently, each model’s off-box mass is averaged over different validation subsets. We also take the union of multiple boxes. Formally, for normalised positive token impacts q i + q_{i}^{+} and the set of tokens 𝒢 \mathcal{G} inside the box, this is m = ∑ i ∉ 𝒢 q i + ( N − | 𝒢 | ) / N , m=\frac{\sum_{i\notin\mathcal{G}}q_{i}^{+}}{(N-|\mathcal{G}|)/N}, (9) where dividing by the fraction of tokens outside the box normalises for box size, to give a mass value over the whole image and not an average per token. Therefore, uniformly spread impact over all tokens gives m = 1 m=1 and lower values indicate impact concentrated on the object. blocks.en: The results are shown in Figs. 5 , 6 and 1 . Class-wise effective support and prediction stability are clearly correlated in Fig. 5 (Pearson correlation 0.86). Under a 10% keep budget, broad class evidence survives most sampled token selections, while concentrated evidence survives only when its few tokens are kept, which needs precise token selection but could allow more aggressive pruning. The qualitative examples in Fig. 6 suggest that classes occupying more of the image tend to have broader effective support and images from the same class can still have varied effective support. The highlighted classes in Fig. 5 recur for the other coherent models (Supp. Figs. 18 , 18 and 18 ): screwdriver stays at the low-support end and jigsaw puzzle at the high end, and junco and other birds are always among the classes furthest below the trend, keeping their prediction more often than their concentrated support suggests.

blocks.en: SigLIP 2 is a notable outlier in terms of coherence ρ \rho , stability s ^ \hat{s} and off-box mass m m under token pruning in comparison to the other models evaluated ( Tab. 1 ). In addition to this, we note that for SigLIP 2 the patch tokens of highest average impact are consistently located in corner regions of the image (Supp. Fig. 13 ). SigLIP 2’s behaviour is not explained by its pretraining objective alone: TIPSv2, also trained on image-text pairs, remains coherent ( ρ = 0.82 \rho{=}0.82 , Tab. 1 ). What SigLIP 2 alone lacks is prefix tokens, as every other backbone carries at least a [CLS] token. Building on Darcet et al. [22] , who showed that high-norm tokens hold global context, we hypothesise that the absence of prefix tokens in SigLIP 2 leads to high-norm sink tokens forming on patch tokens, which are not protected from pruning, rather than on prefix tokens, which are. Pruning these high-norm tokens during MCTP then corrupts the representation, resulting in this outlier behaviour.

blocks.en: A: Pruning the high-norm sink tokens that hold global context collapses the prediction, and with it Coherent Aggregation . In most models these include prefix tokens [ 22 ] , which pruning protects, but the prefix-free SigLIP 2 forms them on patch tokens, which pruning removes. Protecting SigLIP 2’s five highest-norm tokens improves its MCTP object alignment and prediction stability and doubles its coherence between depths 3 and 6.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Limitations. MCTP is too costly to make pruning decisions at inference, so we design it as a post-hoc analysis tool that allows us to explore how pretrained models respond to pruning, with its cost paid only once per model. We do not evaluate existing token pruning methods, nor propose a new pruning method: protecting sink tokens here tests why SigLIP 2 fails under pruning, and its effect within existing methods remains future work. However, what remains uncertain is whether image context is required outside of the high token impact regions under pruning. Of the eight models we evaluate, only SigLIP 2 shows low Coherent Aggregation , so our sink interventions only cover a single prefix-free model; however SigLIP encoders [ 71 , 83 ] are the vision encoders widely used in VLM such as PaliGemma [ 7 , 66 ] and LLaVA-OneVision [ 47 ] . Lastly, protecting tokens cannot help at l = 0 l{=}0 , as the model has not yet embedded image context into any patch tokens.
blocks.zh: 限制。 MCTP成本太高,无法在推论中做出裁量决定,所以我们把它设计成一个后热分析工具,使我们能够探索预先训练过的模型如何应对裁量,每个模型只支付一次成本. 我们不评估现有的信使跑道方法,也不提议新的信使跑道方法:在这里保护信使跑道工具,测试SigLIP 2为何在跑道中失败,它在现有方法内的效果仍然是未来的工作。 然而,仍然不确定的是,在受冲击的高象征性影响区域之外是否需要图像背景。 在我们评价的8个模型中,只有SigLIP 2显示低相干聚合,因此我们的沉积干预只涵盖一个单一的无前缀模型;然而SigLIP编码器[71,83]是VLM中被广泛使用的视觉编码器,如PaliGemma[7,66]和LLaVA-One Visiion[47]. 最后,保护令牌在l=0 l{=}0时无法帮助,因为模型还没有将图像上下文嵌入到任何补丁令牌中.

blocks.en:
Future Work. We will expand our analysis to cover dense predictions, which is fundamentally more difficult under token reduction [ 48 , 68 , 50 , 6 , 84 , 78 ] .
Further, expanding this work to other common token reduction approaches would help generalise these findings, for example with token merging or adaptive patch sizing. We also hope MCTP informs future token reduction methods, for example in the choice of pretrained model, re-using pruning decisions across depths in coherent models to save compute, or estimating pruning aggression per class from its effective support. Lastly, approximating MCTP at inference with uncertainty-driven approaches could help drive cheaper, higher quality pruning decisions.
blocks.zh:
未来活计. 我们将扩大分析范围,以涵盖密集的预测,这在象征性的减少[48、68、50、6、84、78]之下从根本上更为困难。
此外,将这项工作扩大到其他共同的象征性减少办法将有助于概括这些结论,例如象征性的合并或适应性地拼接。 我们还希望MCTP为未来的象征性削减方法提供信息,例如选择经过预先训练的模型,在连贯的模型中重新使用贯穿深度的决定来节省计算,或者从有效支持中估计每类入侵。 最后,以不确定因素驱动的方法作为推断依据,可以帮助作出更便宜、质量更佳的决定。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In summary, we used MCTP to investigate how pretrained models respond to pruning and how their token importance rankings develop through ViT depth. We found that a model’s predictions under pruning depend on whether its high-norm sink tokens are kept, and that its Coherent Aggregation breaks when those predictions collapse. Removing DINOv3’s prefix tokens collapsed its stability, while protecting only 5 of SigLIP 2’s 441 tokens considerably raised it. Our results therefore suggest that token pruning should protect sink tokens: models trained with prefix tokens get this for free, while prefix-free models need their highest-norm tokens kept under pruning. Attention-based scores [ 49 , 81 ] and learned pruning modules [ 59 , 6 ] already tend to keep these high-norm patch tokens implicitly; we hope our analysis of why these tokens matter guides future designs to protect sink tokens explicitly, such as registers or high-norm patch tokens, during token reduction.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们利用MCTP来调查预先训练过的模型如何应对被挤压的情况,以及它们的象征性重要性排名如何通过VIT深度发展. 我们发现,一个模型的预测正在被推敲,这取决于其高标准沉淀物是否保存下来,而当这些预测崩溃时,它的一致聚合就会破裂。 拆除DINOv3的前缀标志会崩溃, 因此,我们的结果表明道具普鲁能应该保护下沉道具:训练有前缀道具的模型免费获得,而道具前缀道具则需要保留在道具下的最高规范道具. 基于注意的分数[49,81]和所学的打分模块[59,6]已经倾向于隐含地保留这些高规范的补丁符号;我们希望我们对为什么这些补丁符号重要的分析能指导未来设计,在降标时明确保护下沉符号,如登记或高规范的补丁符号.

blocks.en: To test how much prediction stability depends on the model rather than the data, we rank the 1,000 ImageNet-1k classes by s ^ ​ ( k ) \hat{s}(k) and compare these rankings between models using Spearman correlation. At l = 3 l{=}3 ( l = 6 l{=}6 for L/16), the 7 backbones other than SigLIP 2 rank the classes by s ^ ​ ( k ) \hat{s}(k) similarly, with correlations of 0.70–0.96 between every pair of models (0.92–0.96 between the 3 DINOv3 sizes), and their rankings by effective support ϕ + ​ ( k ) \phi^{+}(k) agree just as closely (0.76–0.96). Which classes keep their prediction is therefore largely set by the images: at a 10% keep budget, s ^ ​ ( k ) \hat{s}(k) measures whether a small region of the image suffices to classify it, as well as how the model responds to losing the rest. SigLIP 2 is the exception: it keeps almost no predictions at l = 3 l{=}3 , and even at l = 9 l{=}9 , where 38.8% of its draws keep the prediction, its rankings correlate with the other models at only 0.38–0.46 for s ^ ​ ( k ) \hat{s}(k) and 0.32–0.38 for ϕ + ​ ( k ) \phi^{+}(k) .
